newsitem.title: USA: Housecall shares sink after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Housecall shares sink after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in home healthcare services company Housecall Medical Resources Inc fell more than 50 percent on Thursday after the company said it expected a net loss for the fiscal fourth quarter.
Morgan Stanley said it downgraded the stock to underperform from outperform.
Housecall was off 7-3/8 to 7-1/8 in morning trading. The Atlanta-based company went public in April at $16 a share.
Wall Street had expected the company to earn $0.17 a share in its fourth quarter, ended June 30, according to First Call.
Housecall said fourth quarter earnings and revenues were expected to fall short of expectations.

It said its non-Medicare infusion therapy, hospice and nursing services businesses failed to meet budgeted revenues. It also cited a limitation on Medicare reimbursement for some services provided during the quarter.
